instruction: How much money have I been requested on Venmo in the last 5 days (including today)?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so the only state changes are knowledge predicates. The window is 5 days including today (2023-05-30 through 2023-06-03), derived from the given current datetime, so no phone date lookup is needed. The lookup action venmo-show-received-payment-requests asserts (found-requested-total ?amt); at runtime the agent may need to call it for several page_index values and sums the amounts of all requests created in the window regardless of status. supervisor-complete-task takes the computed total as its `answer` and is forced to be last via (task-completed).
